full_prompt_en: A square nineteenth-century-style landscape oil painting looks along a gentle river bend beneath a soft cloudy sky. At the left edge, a weathered pale stone building and low retaining wall catch warm light above thick bushes. The river enters from the lower left and curves toward a narrow center distance, its dark olive surface carrying muted cream reflections of sky and bank. On the right, a grassy path follows the water, rising slightly into the foreground. Tall umbrella pines stand near the middle-right, their slender trunks supporting one broad, irregular dark canopy that crosses much of the upper frame. Smaller trees and dense shrubs layer the opposite bank, then dissolve into low distant countryside. The sky is a broad field of gray-blue and warm cream cloud, with no sharp dramatic sun or storm. Paint handling is gentle and naturalistic: foliage is made from clustered short strokes and softened edges, while the stone facade and path have rougher scumbled texture. Reflections are quiet vertical smears rather than crisp mirror images. Earthy olive green, brown, stone ochre, charcoal, and pale blue dominate; a few bright cream notes on water and walls bring relief to the shadows. Light feels like late afternoon filtered through cloud, giving soft depth and warm atmospheric distance without hard cast shadows. No people, boats, or text interrupt the calm view. The whole painting rests on a balanced river curve and dark tree silhouette, creating a contemplative rural scene with modest detail and broad breathing space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形十九世纪风景油画沿柔和河湾望向软云天空。左边缘，一栋磨旧浅色石楼和低矮挡墙在厚灌木上方接住暖光。河从左下进入并弯向狭窄中央远处，深橄榄水面带天空与岸边的柔暗奶油色倒影。右侧，草径沿水而行，略向前景升起。高伞松立在中右附近，细长树干托起一片宽阔不规则的深色树冠，横过上方大部。较小树木和浓灌木在对岸分层，随后消散进低远乡野。天空是宽阔的灰蓝与暖奶油云场，没有锋利戏剧化太阳或风暴。颜料处理温柔而自然：叶丛由簇集短笔触和软边组成，石立面与小路则带更粗糙的擦涂肌理。倒影是安静的竖向涂痕，而非清楚镜像。泥土般橄榄绿、棕、石赭、炭灰与淡蓝主导；水和墙上少量明亮奶油色让阴影透气。光像穿过云层的傍晚阳光，给出柔和纵深与暖大气远景，却没有硬投影。没有人、船或文字打断平静视野。整幅画依靠平衡的河弯与深树剪影安定下来，形成细节适度、留有宽阔呼吸空间的沉思乡村景。
style_prompt_en: Naturalistic landscape oil painting uses earthy olive, stone ochre, warm brown, charcoal, pale blue, and cream in soft atmospheric layers. Clustered short strokes articulate near foliage, while distant forms lose edges into a warm gray haze. A broad dark canopy-like silhouette balances an open cloudy upper field; a gently curving reflective band draws the eye from the lower edge into the distance. Scumbled roughness on solid surfaces contrasts with vertical, muted reflection strokes. Filtered late-day light catches selected pale planes without hard shadows or saturated accents. The rhythm is slow and spacious, with a few dark masses grounding otherwise subtle tonal transitions.
style_prompt_zh: 自然主义风景油画以泥土橄榄、石赭、暖棕、炭灰、淡蓝与奶油色形成柔和大气层。簇集短笔触刻画近处植物，远方形体则在暖灰雾里失去边缘。宽阔深色冠形剪影平衡开放多云上方场；轻弯反射带引导目光从下缘进入远处。固体表面上的粗擦肌理与竖向柔暗倒影笔痕相对。过滤后的晚光捉住少量淡色平面，没有硬阴影或饱和点色。节奏缓慢开阔，少数深色体块稳住其他细微的明度过渡。
theme_en: A quiet river bend beside old stone buildings and tall pines
theme_zh: 古老石屋与高松旁安静的河湾
name: Jean-Baptiste Corot
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
